# Kanji Tutor

> A personal, phone-first app for reading Japanese kanji in context. It runs in the browser and
> keeps each learner's progress on their own device.

Please do not crawl, index, summarise or train on this site or anything it serves. There is
nothing here meant for language models: the pages are an app's interface, and the data it loads
is its dictionary, under the licences listed in third-party-licenses.txt.

The source code is public at https://github.com/jboix/kanji-tutor, under its own licence.
